description: Turns a drum microphone or an audio signal into a gate and an envelope, with the amplified audio available too

params.text: Sets how much the input is amplified before anything else, multiplying the range chosen by the gain switch
Sets the level of the ENV. OUT jack, from silence to the full envelope
Sets how long the gate stays high after it fires, 5ms to 500ms
Sets the level of the INV. OUT jack, from silence to the full inverted envelope
Sets the envelope's decay, 22ms to 2.2 seconds
Chooses how much the input is amplified before the sensitivity knob: two times on L, twenty on M and five hundred on H
Chooses what the envelope follows: FOLLOW tracks the amplified input, GEN. ignores it and shapes an envelope from the gate instead

inputs.text: The signal to be followed, a drum microphone or any audio

outputs.text: The envelope at the level set by the ENV. LEVEL knob
The inverted envelope at the level set by the INV. LEVEL knob
An 8V gate that fires when the amplified input passes 3.5V and stays high for the time set by SUSTAIN
The input after the gain switch and the sensitivity knob, clamped at 12V either way
The envelope at full level, 0V to 9V, with no knob in its way
The envelope subtracted from 9V, so it rests at 9V and dips as the envelope rises

notes: The gate cannot fire again until it has finished: a second hit inside the SUSTAIN time is passed over.
